title: SMOTE 25 Years of Magic: What Has Been Done, What the Evidence Shows, and Whom It Reached
abstract: arXiv:2611.34511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background. SMOTE was published in this journal in 2002 and reviewed here at its fifteenth anniversary in 2018. At twenty-five it is cited by more than 34,000 indexed works, half of them outside computer science. Objectives. To establish what the methods built on SMOTE change, how strong the evidence for them is, and whom the technique has reached. Methods. We audited a curated corpus of 76 papers, 37 of which propose a SMOTE-family generator, and tested its coverage with a systematic search of 22,426 records in the PRISMA 2020 format. From the corpus we collected 1,756 dataset entries, 1,511 published comparisons with SMOTE and the evaluation design of 71 studies; from the search we drew 300 applications of SMOTE at random. translated_title: SMOTE的25年魔力：已做之事、证据所示及其影响力所及
translated_abstract: 背景。SMOTE于2002年发表在本期刊上，并于2018年其十五周年之际在本刊进行了回顾综述。至其二十五周年时，它已被超过34,000篇收录文献引用，其中一半来自计算机科学领域之外。目标。确定基于SMOTE构建的方法改变了什么、这些方法的证据强度如何，以及该技术已经触及了哪些领域。方法。我们审计了一个精选的76篇论文语料库，其中37篇提出了SMOTE家族的生成器，并通过以PRISMA 2020格式对22,426条记录进行系统检索来检验该语料库的覆盖范围。我们从语料库中收集了1,756个数据集条目、1,511项与SMOTE的已发表比较以及71项研究的评估设计；并从系统检索中随机抽取了300项SMOTE的应用案例。我们采用智能体AI方法在既定书面规则下进行提取、筛选和编码，并报告了每个步骤的核查方式。结果。每个变体都会重新决定SMOTE规则的六个决策中的某些部分，其中24个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 在SMOTE问世25周年之际，本研究通过审计76篇论文语料库并对22,426条记录进行系统性检索，评估了SMOTE家族方法的改进内容、证据强度及其跨学科的影响力范围。
en_tdlr: At SMOTE's 25th anniversary, this study audits a corpus of 76 papers and systematically searches 22,426 records to assess what SMOTE-family methods change, how strong the evidence for them is, and whom the technique has reached.
